summary: Develop DMAIC, data analysis, and process improvement skills in PECB Six Sigma Green Belt training. Prepare for the exam and earn 31 CPD credits.
audienceIntro: Six Sigma Green Belt training is designed for people who work directly on process improvement projects and need structured methods for defining problems, analyzing data, and supporting process changes.
prerequisites: The course materials do not state prerequisites for attending the training. To apply for the PECB Certified Six Sigma Green Belt credential, PECB lists the Green Belt exam or equivalent, three years of professional experience including two years of work experience with Six Sigma projects, 200 hours of Six Sigma project activities, and signing the PECB Code of Ethics. The PECB Certified Six Sigma Provisional Green Belt credential requires the exam or equivalent and signing the Code of Ethics, with no professional or project experience listed.
